summary: Verified the AlertDialog rendering fix (Radix Portal + opacity-only .animate-fade-up) works correctly on BOTH desktop (1920x1080) AND mobile (390x844) viewports for /pedidos (delete PED-0009 dialog) and /notificar (delete-notif-dialog). Also verified the new Notificar feature end-to-end (create, list, delete, broadcast, TopBar bell + unread badge + panel + Gerenciar link). All 7 backend tests for /api/notifications pass. Regression check: regular Dialog (Novo Pedido) still opens and works.

issues: Cosmetic only: On desktop the AlertDialog has sm:rounded-lg but no rounding on mobile viewport (full-width, sharp corners) — this is Radix default; still fully readable and buttons clickable. Not a blocker.

Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — accessibility warning on some Dialogs (e.g. Sheet / Novo Pedido). Not blocking, but worth adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for a11y.

action_items: Minor: The review request mentioned data-testids `delete-order-dialog` and `order-delete-{id}` in /pedidos — these are NOT present in /app/frontend/src/pages/Pedidos.js. Consider adding them for future testability (functionality already works). Test was performed via role selector + button text ('Excluir pedido?', 'Cancelar') instead.
Minor a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Dialogs to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AlertDialog fix (Portal + opacity-only .animate-fade-up) is correct — verified visually that the dialog renders centered above the overlay on both desktop and mobile.
Pedidos.js is 1045 lines — consider splitting into smaller files (AddSupplierDialog, NewOrderDialog, OrderCard, OrderGrid) for maintainability.
Pedidos delete trash button and its AlertDialog lack data-testid attributes (only nav/tab/testid=order-grid), reducing testability.
test_credentials: laboratoriolumix@outlook.com / Lumix2002 (Laboratório); leonicelaboratorio@lumix.com / Lumix2002 (Pedidos). Both worked via /api/auth/login (response key is `token`, not `access_token`).
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up test notifications with product_name prefix TEST_PW_* via UI. Backend tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up via module-scope fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend token key from /api/auth/login is `token` (not `access_token`). Pedidos delete AlertDialog can be triggered by clicking `button.text-red-600` (Trash2 icon) on an order card and detected by role=alertdialog or h2 text 'Excluir pedido?'. Notificar page fully instrumented with data-testid (notif-product-input, notif-message-input, notif-submit-button, notif-item-{id}, notif-delete-{id}, delete-notif-dialog, notif-delete-cancel, notif-delete-confirm). TopBar bell selectors: topbar-notifications, notif-badge, notification-panel, notif-panel-link.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — the AlertDialog bug was already fixed by the main agent (Radix Portal wrap + removed transform from .animate-fade-up). This iteration verified the fix works on desktop and mobile: the dialog content renders inside the viewport, centered, with readable title 'Excluir pedido?' / 'Remover notificação?' and both Cancelar/Excluir(Remover) buttons clickable. No dark blank overlay observed.
